'''Sandeep Verma''' is an Indian [[Bioorganic chemistry|bioorganic chemist]] and [[Chemical biology|chemical biologist]], and a Professor in the Department of Chemistry at the [[Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur]] (IITK).<ref name="Professor, IIT Kanpur">{{Cite web |url=https://globalprofessorrank.com/professors/sandeep-verma |title=Professor, IIT Kanpur |date=2016 |publisher=Global Professor Rank}}</ref> At IITK, he heads Sandeep Verma's Research Group<ref name="Sandeep Verma's Research Group">{{Cite web |url=https://www.iitk.ac.in/new/sandeep-verma |title=Sandeep Verma's Research Group}}</ref> in the areas of ordered [[peptide]] assemblies, microfluidic diagnostic systems, programmable soft matter for neuronal regeneration, novel antimicrobials, and small molecule-stem cell modulation.<ref name="Brief Profile of the Awardee">{{Cite web |url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/Content/Detail.aspx?AID=131 |title=Brief Profile of the Awardee |date=2016 |publisher=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize |access-date=12 November 2016}}</ref> He is an elected fellow of the [[Indian National Science Academy]] (INSA), the [[Indian Academy of Sciences]],<ref name="Fellow profile">{{Cite web |url=http://www.ias.ac.in/describe/fellow/Verma,_Prof._Sandeep |title=Fellow profile |date=2016 |publisher=Indian Academy of Sciences}}</ref> the [[National Academy of Sciences, India]],<ref name="NASI Fellows">{{Cite web |url=http://nasi.org.in/fellows.asp?RsFilter=V |title=NASI fellows |date=2016 |publisher=National Academy of Sciences, India}}</ref> and the [[Indian National Academy of Engineering]]. The [[Council of Scientific and Industrial Research]], the apex agency of the Government of India for scientific research, awarded him the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology]], one of the highest Indian science awards, in 2010, for his contributions to Chemical Sciences.<ref name="View Bhatnagar Awardees">{{cite web | url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/Content/AwardeeList.aspx | title=View Bhatnagar Awardees | publisher=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize | date=2016 | accessdate=12 November 2016}}</ref> In the years 2011 and 2013, he was awarded a Senior Fellowship of the Zukunftskollegs at the University of Konstanz.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Senior Fellows |url=https://www.uni-konstanz.de/zukunftskolleg/community/senior-fellows/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251113030025/https://www.uni-konstanz.de/zukunftskolleg/community/senior-fellows/ |archive-date=2025-11-13 |access-date=2026-10-25 |website=www.uni-konstanz.de}}</ref> At present, he is heading the Gangwal School of Medical Sciences and Technology, IIT Kanpur [https://iitk.ac.in/webtheme/gsmst/<nowiki>].</nowiki>

== Biography ==
Born in Kanpur in the Indian state of [[Uttar Pradesh]], Sandeep Verma did his early schooling in [[Varanasi]] and completed his Master's degree at [[Banaras Hindu University]] in 1989.<ref name="Professor Sandeep Verma of IIT-Kanpur and BHU alumnus receives Bhatnagar Prize">{{Cite web |url=http://www.itbhuglobal.org/chronicle/archives/2010/09/professor_sande.php |title=Professor Sandeep Verma of IIT-Kanpur and BHU alumnus receives Bhatnagar Prize |date=2016 |publisher=IIT-BHU Chronicle}}</ref> Subsequently, he secured a PhD from the [[University of Illinois Medical Center]], Chicago in 1994 and he did his post-doctoral work, first at [[Johns Hopkins University]] and later at the [[Max Planck Institute for Experimental Medicine]].<ref name="Thematic Unit of Excellence">{{Cite web |url=http://www.iitk.ac.in/nanoscience/coord.html |title=Thematic Unit of Excellence |date=2016 |publisher=IIT Kanpur}}</ref> He joined the [[Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur]] as an Assistant Professor and is currently working as a Professor.<ref name="Faculty profile">{{Cite web |url=http://www.iitk.ac.in/new/sandeep-verma |title=Faculty profile |date=2016 |publisher=Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur}}</ref>

== Research Profile ==
Verma's researches may broadly be classified into four segments: Ordered Peptide Assemblies,<ref name="Peptide-based Synthetic Design, Construction and Morphology of Soft Structures">{{Cite journal |title=Peptide-based Synthetic Design, Construction and Morphology of Soft Structures|year=2012|pmid=23394277|last1=Mondal|first1=S.|last2=Barman|first2=A. K.|last3=Verma|first3=S.|journal=CHIMIA|volume=66|issue=12|pages=930–5|doi=10.2533/chimia.2012.930|doi-access=free}}</ref> Metal-Mediated Systems,<ref name="Directed Adenine Functionalization for Creating Complex Architectures for Material and Biological Applications">{{Cite journal |title=Directed Adenine Functionalization for Creating Complex Architectures for Material and Biological Applications|year=2017|pmid=28393940|last1=Mohapatra|first1=B.|last2=Verma|first2=S.|journal=Chemical Communications|volume=53|issue=35|pages=4748–4758|doi=10.1039/c7cc00222j}}</ref> New [[Antimicrobial]]s<ref name="A Novel Molecular Scaffold Resensitizes Multidrug-Resistant S. Aureus to Fluoroquinolones">{{Cite journal |title=A Novel Molecular Scaffold Resensitizes Multidrug-Resistant S. Aureus to Fluoroquinolones|year=2019|pmid=31276129|last1=Panjla|first1=A.|last2=Kaul|first2=G.|last3=Shukla|first3=M.|last4=Tripathi|first4=S.|last5=Nair|first5=N. N.|last6=Chopra|first6=S.|last7=Verma|first7=S.|journal=Chemical Communications|volume=55|issue=59|pages=8599–8602|doi=10.1039/c9cc03001h|s2cid=206141691 }}</ref> and Small Molecule [[Stem cell|Stem Cell]] Interaction.<ref name="Tripeptide-induced Modulation of Mesenchymal Stem Cell Biomechanics Stimulates Proliferation and Wound Healing">{{Cite journal |title=Tripeptide-induced Modulation of Mesenchymal Stem Cell Biomechanics Stimulates Proliferation and Wound Healing|year=2020|pmid=32048649|last1=Sharma|first1=S.|last2=Kulkarni|first2=C.|last3=Kulkarni|first3=M. M.|last4=Ali|first4=R.|last5=Porwal|first5=K.|last6=Chattopadhyay|first6=N.|last7=Tewari|first7=D.|last8=Verma|first8=S.|journal=Chemical Communications|volume=56|issue=20|pages=3043–3046|doi=10.1039/c9cc10043a|s2cid=211084849 }}</ref> He is credited with the synthesis of [[enzyme mimic]]s using metal-mediated systems and his group is involved in developing bio-inspired soft matter and protocols for using biological building blocks as diagnostic tools for diseases.<ref name="Ultrasensitive NO X Detection in Simulated Exhaled Air: Enhanced Sensing via Alumina Modification of In-Situ Grown WO 3 Nanoblocks">{{Cite journal |title=Ultrasensitive NO X Detection in Simulated Exhaled Air: Enhanced Sensing via Alumina Modification of In-Situ Grown WO 3 Nanoblocks|year=2019|pmid=31420935|last1=Alam|first1=S.|last2=Ansari|first2=M. S.|last3=Banik|first3=A.|last4=Ali|first4=R.|last5=Verma|first5=S.|last6=Qureshi|first6=M.|journal=Chemistry: An Asian Journal|volume=14|issue=24|pages=4673–4680|doi=10.1002/asia.201900699|s2cid=201041534 }}</ref><ref name="Purine-blended Nanofiber Woven Flexible Nanomats for SERS-based Analyte Detection">{{Cite journal |title=Purine-blended Nanofiber Woven Flexible Nanomats for SERS-based Analyte Detection|year=2020|pmid=32323673|last1=Saravanan|first1=R. K.|last2=Naqvi|first2=T. K.|last3=Patil|first3=S.|last4=Dwivedi|first4=P. K.|last5=Verma|first5=S.|journal=Chemical Communications|volume=56|issue=43|pages=5795–5798|doi=10.1039/d0cc00648c|s2cid=216083483 }}</ref> His research has been documented in a number of peer-reviewed articles, reviews and book chapters.<ref name="Sandeep Verma's Research Group"/> He serves as an Associate Editor of [[Chemical Communications]] (RSC, UK)<ref name="A warm welcome to Sandeep Verma, our new ChemComm Associate Editor">{{Cite web |url=https://blogs.rsc.org/cc/2017/07/25/welcome-sandeep-verma-new-chemcomm-associate-editor/ |title=A warm welcome to Sandeep Verma, our new ChemComm Associate Editor}}</ref> and served on the Editorial Advisory Boards of [[Cell Chemical Biology]],<ref name="Editorial Board: Cell Chemical Biology">{{Cite web |url=https://www.cell.com/cell-chemical-biology/editorial-board |title=Editorial Board: Cell Chemical Biology}}</ref> [[ChemBioChem]]<ref name="ChemBioChem: Editorial Board">{{Cite web |url=https://chemistry-europe.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/hub/journal/14397633/editorial-board |title=ChemBioChem: Editorial Board|doi=10.1002/(ISSN)1439-7633 }}</ref> and [[Journal of Peptide Science]].<ref name="Journal of Peptide Science: Editorial Board">{{Cite web |url=https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/page/journal/10991387/homepage/editorialboard.html |title=Journal of Peptide Science: Editorial Board|doi=10.1002/(ISSN)1099-1387 }}</ref>

== Awards and honours ==
Verma won the Jawaharlal Nehru Memorial Fund Award, [[P. M. Bhargava]] Medal and [[Banaras Hindu University|BHU]] Vice Chancellor's Gold Medal for academic excellence in master's degree examination in 1989, and the J. Watumull Endowed Award of the [[University of Illinois at Chicago]] in 1993. He won the [[Brij Mohan Birla|B. M. Birla]] Science Prize (2003),<ref name="B. M. Birla Science Prize">{{Cite web |url=http://www.birlasciencecentre.org/awards/birlaSciencePrizes/ |title=B. M. Birla Science Prize |date=2016 |publisher=B. M. Birla Science Centre |access-date=5 December 2016 |archive-date=28 January 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180128175901/http://www.birlasciencecentre.org/awards/birlaSciencePrizes/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> Swarnajayanti Fellowship (2005) in Chemical Sciences,<ref name="Swarnajayanti Fellowships">{{Cite web |url=https://www.serc-dst.org/swarnajayanti.html |title=Swarnajayanti Fellowships }}{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> and Bronze Medal (2005) of the [[Chemical Research Society of India]]. The [[Council of Scientific and Industrial Research]] awarded him the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize]], one of the highest Indian science awards, in 2010.<ref name="Chemical Sciences">{{cite web | url=http://www.csir.res.in/External/Heads/career/award/BPRIZE/CHEMICAL_SCIENCES.htm | title=Chemical Sciences | publisher=Council of Scientific and Industrial Research | date=2016 | url-status=dead | archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120912012851/http://www.csir.res.in/external/heads/career/award/BPRIZE/CHEMICAL_SCIENCES.htm | archivedate=12 September 2012 | df=dmy-all }}</ref> He was bestowed with Doctor of Philosophy (''Honoris Causa'') by Goethe University Frankfurt (Germany) and Doctor of Science (''Honoris Causa'') by Amity University Rajasthan, Jaipur, in 2025 [https://aktuelles.uni-frankfurt.de/en/forschung/chemiker-sandeep-verma-erhaelt-ehrendoktorwuerde-der-goethe-universitaet/<nowiki>] [</nowiki>https://www.linkedin.com/posts/amityuniversityjaipur_aurconvocation2024-amityuniversityjaipur-activity-7301923571184885760-YG0w/<nowiki>].</nowiki>

He is an elected fellow of the [[Indian National Science Academy]] (INSA), [[Indian Academy of Sciences]], the [[National Academy of Sciences, India]], the [[Indian National Academy of Engineering]] (INAE) and a Senior Fellow of the Zukunftskolleg, [[University of Konstanz]], Germany.<ref name="Second stay of Sandeep Verma at the Zukunftskolleg">{{Cite web |url=https://www.uni-konstanz.de/zukunftskolleg/news/current-news/single-news/Second-stay-of-Sandeep-Verma-at-the-Zukunftskolleg/ |title=Second stay of Sandeep Verma at the Zukunftskolleg}}</ref> He was awarded the Silver Medal (2017) of the [[Chemical Research Society of India]],<ref name="23rd CRSI National Symposium in Chemistry">{{Cite web |url=https://chm.iiserb.ac.in/conf/crsi/speakers.php |title=23rd CRSI National Symposium in Chemistry}}</ref> National Prize for Research on Interfaces between Chemistry and Biology (2017),<ref name="Research needs to be multi-disciplinary: Award-winning duo, Times of India">{{Cite news |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/bengaluru/research-needs-to-be-multi-disciplinary-award-winning-duo/articleshow/59010729.cms |title=Research needs to be multi-disciplinary: Award-winning duo, Times of India|website=[[The Times of India]] |date=6 June 2017 }}</ref> MRSI-ICSC Superconductivity & Materials Science Annual Prize (2018), Materials Research Society of India,<ref name="MRSI Awards and Honours">{{Cite web |url=https://www.mrsi.org.in/awardshonours.php |title=MRSI Awards and Honours}}</ref> Goyal Prize (2019) in Chemical Sciences,<ref name="Dainik Bhaskar Jan 15, 2019">{{Cite web |url=https://www.bhaskar.com/harayana/kurukshetra/news/haryana-news-pro-lakshmikantam-prof-sandeep-verma-and-prof-goyal-award-for-umesh-anniversary-024023-3667150.html |title=Dainik Bhaskar Jan 15, 2019}}</ref> the Distinguished Alumnus Award (2020), [[Banaras Hindu University]],<ref name="Twitter">{{cite tweet |user=VCofficeBHU |number=1218077536678182915 |date=17 January 2020 |title=Prof. Sandeep Verma, Secretary, SERB, New Delhi, receiving the #BHU Distinguished Alumnus Award. @bhupro}}</ref> and more recently, the Society of Materials Chemistry Gold Medal - 2022, [[Bhabha Atomic Research Centre|Bhabha Atomic Research Center, Mumbai]].

== Science Governance ==
Sandeep Verma served as the Secretary of the [[Science and Engineering Research Board]] (SERB) from April 2019 till October 2022.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Secretary's Page: Science and Engineering Research Board |url=http://serb.gov.in/secretary.php#:~:text=Sandeep%20Verma%20took%20charge%20as,Prof. |access-date=18 May 2022 |website=serb.gov.in}}</ref>
